currentTaskUserReference.rule: When a current-task user reference is present and visual-match intent is explicit, it outranks Product Master for visual authority. If a prior reference is requested but cannot be recovered, block instead of falling back.

agencyDashboard.reason: Multiple approved/current Agency dashboard families exist and generic dashboard intent cannot override an exact user visual reference.

lockRule: Reference-based CREATE/MODIFY/FIX requires Reference Lock before Visual Grammar Extraction and Design Decision.
substitutionRule: A locked user visual reference cannot be replaced by Product Master, generic family, current target, or inferred content. Product Master and Core DS may only occupy supporting authority lanes.
writeRule: CREATE_SCREEN and MODIFY_SCREEN require PASS or EXPLORE_EXPLICIT plus all write guards before Figma mutation.
